rationale: Both candidates independently rediscovered the ground truth's core still-live concern (the MiniMax-H3 0.17 default never reaches serving because async_omni_engine hardcodes 0.2), with equally strong file/line evidence and fix suggestions, and both correctly validated that the FL2VA-partition gating and offline-example fixes already hold. Y goes further with a rigorous, self-computed analysis showing the calibrated threshold polynomial is near-constant and non-monotone (directly relevant to GT's 'material quality loss' theme), plus sharp test-coverage critiques (cache-hit test can't catch stale t_emb, e2e smoke can't detect a no-op cache) and a TP-rank-consistency check X never attempts. X adds one plausible but unverifiable Cache-DiT/TeaCache conflict claim and useful CI/docs findings, but pads with lower-value cosmetic items and slightly overstates the AMD CI causality that GT already dismissed as an expired/unrelated build.
